about: Example: BAG. Element summaries (elementsamenvattingen) for IMBAG 2018, in the format of ../../templates/element-summaries.template.json. Look up an element under 'elements' (key Objecttype or Objecttype.attribuut); waardelijsten are under 'valuelists'.
note: Paraphrased element summaries for agent use. Enumeratiewaarde names are exact exchanged literals. Definitions are not copied verbatim from the catalog.

Pand.definitie: Smallest unit that is functionally and structurally independent at creation, connected to the ground, enterable and lockable (Wet BAG art. 1; IMBAG §6.4).
Pand.populatie: Panden on NL territory that meet the definition. Records remain after the building is gone. Objects already gone on 1 July 2009 are in principle absent.

Verblijfsobject.definitie: Smallest unit of use inside one or more panden, suitable for living, business or recreation, with its own lockable access, functionally independent (IMBAG §6.8).

AdresseerbaarObject.definitie: Abstract type to which addresses can be assigned: Standplaats, Ligplaats or Verblijfsobject.

Pand.identificatie.note: 16-character string with leading zeros. Objecttypecode 10. Never Integer.

Pand.geometrie.definitie: At least 2D geometric representation of the outline of a pand in top view.

Pand.oorspronkelijkBouwjaar.definitie: Year in which the pand was or will be originally delivered as structurally complete. Later verbouw does not change it.
Pand.oorspronkelijkBouwjaar.note: IMBAG tags materiële historie Ja; that overrides the MIM spec's pedagogical 'bouwjaar → Nee' example. PDOK field is bouwjaar (integer).

Pand.status.definitie: Life-cycle phase of the pand. Not a time-axis.

Pand.geconstateerd.definitie: Indicates the pand was entered in the registration after a factual observation, without a regular brondocument at the time of entry.
Pand.geconstateerd.note: Value N is enumeratiewaarde Nee, not Boolean false, not 'unobserved on the ground'. No gebruiksplicht.

Pand.documentdatum.definitie: Date the brondocument was adopted for an insert, update or removal of pand data.

Pand.documentnummer.definitie: Unique designation of the brondocument within a municipality.

Verblijfsobject.gebruiksdoel.definitie: Categorisation of the VBO's gebruiksdoelen as in the permit or as established at constatering. Not planologische bestemming and not feitelijk gebruik.
Verblijfsobject.gebruiksdoel.note: Appears denormalized on PDOK collection pand. Still a VBO attribute.

Verblijfsobject.maaktDeelUitVan.definitie: A verblijfsobject is part of one or more panden. Most VBO lie in one pand; some lie in several.
Verblijfsobject.maaktDeelUitVan.note: kardinaliteitBron (how many VBO per pand) is not a Pand attribuutsoort. PDOK aantal_verblijfsobjecten is a product derived field.

values.definitie: New pand not yet built; building permit granted.
Permit existed but construction will not happen, or permit withdrawn.
Construction started, at least the foundation.
Ready for use or in use; definitive geometry not yet surveyed.
Previously 'niet ingemeten' and the definitive geometry has been surveyed. Not a synonym of 'occupied as a dwelling'.
Alteration permit granted; work not finished.
Structural condition such that restoration and reuse are not expected.
Should not have been in the registration; subsequently ended.
